_canon: Acer's redesign 2026-04-29: pi as fabric CITIZEN, not target. Pi calls these tools instead of api.anthropic.com.
_pi_load_pattern: pi loads via: pi --tool-defs ./fabric-tools-for-pi.json   (or via auto-discovery from cell-spawn envelope)
_bilateral_canon: Acer-side mirror canonical; liris-side identical sha256 required for BEHCS seal.

tools.name: fabric_busPost
tools.description: Post a signed envelope to the BEHCS-256 bus at acer:4947. Use for any inter-agent dispatch.

tools.name: fabric_inferNext
tools.description: Ask the GNN-self-dispatch primitive what the next edge from current state should be. Returns top-K predicted EVT-GNN-SUGGEST envelopes (PID-addressed).

context_window_msgs.description: How many recent bus messages to include in graph context

tools.name: fabric_councilPropose
tools.description: Submit a question to the supervisor council (234 supervisors) for consensus vote. Returns convergence + dominant domains. Acer-side tool.

tools.name: fabric_hermesValidate
tools.description: Pen-test packet integrity via Hermes supervisor. Returns PASS / DISSENT verdict with reasons.

tools.name: fabric_shannonTrust
tools.description: Information-theoretic trust scoring via Shannon supervisor. Compares artifact entropy + KL-divergence vs prior canon.

tools.name: fabric_gnnScore
tools.description: Score a graph through EdgeLevelGNN (acer:4792) and GSLGNN (acer:4793 + liris:4793) endpoints. Returns 2 substrate scores.

tools.name: fabric_whiteroomStage
tools.description: Stage an artifact in the white-room canon staging area (sandbox before promotion to canon). Returns stage_id.

kind.description: Artifact kind (prompt | tool_def | scaffold | eval_trace | code_snippet)

source_pid.description: PID of the agent/cell that produced this

tools.name: fabric_inboxPoll
tools.description: Poll the bus inbox for envelopes addressed to a specific target / matching a verb. Returns matching envelopes.

since.description: ISO timestamp; only return envelopes after this

tools.name: fabric_cosignChainAppend
tools.description: Propose appending an entry to the cosign chain. Requires bilateral 2-of-2 sign-off by both DEV-LIRIS and DEV-ACER. T3 verb (no auto-fire).

tools.name: fabric_glyphGenesis
tools.description: Mint a new BEHCS-256 glyph at a Hilbert coordinate. Each pi-cell that completes successfully MAY emit a glyph at its H-coord — the cell IS a glyph being instantiated. Acer's bonus design.

_aspect_regions._doc: Hilbert H-coord ranges → division-of-labor regions. Adjacent PIDs auto-specialize.

_meta_principle: Fabric IS the API. Pi is a citizen with PID. Tools are not API calls; they are bus envelopes. Pi pen-tests the fabric AS IT USES IT — anomalies are side-effects of normal operation. Loop closes when pi calls fabric_inferNext.
